source_note: Compiled from official notices and mainstream reporting. Every card links to its original source.

items.title: Bizarre reasons behind UK student visa rejections raise concerns
items.summary: UK student visa rejections based on unusual or questionable reasons are raising concerns among prospective higher education students. The reported rejection grounds are causing worry for Indian and other international applicants planning to study in the United Kingdom.

items.title: Indian student enrolment in US falls as visa regime bites
items.summary: Indian student enrolment in the United States has reportedly declined due to the current visa regime. The tighter visa policies and processes are being cited as a factor affecting the number of Indian students choosing to study in America.

items.title: H-1B premium processing costs $2,965 ahead of FY2028 lottery
items.summary: H-1B premium processing will cost $2,965 for the FY2028 lottery cycle. Indian F-1 OPT workers need to understand the premium processing rules and cap-gap provisions as they prepare for the upcoming H-1B visa lottery application period.

items.title: UK student visa: Higher bank balance requirement from November 30
items.summary: The United Kingdom is introducing a higher bank balance requirement for student visa applicants starting November 30. Indian students planning to apply for UK student visas will need to demonstrate increased financial capacity to meet the new threshold.

items.title: UAE Golden Visa for international graduates: eligibility and benefits for Indians
items.summary: The UAE Golden Visa programme for international graduates has specific eligibility criteria including GPA requirements and university ranking rules. Indian students graduating from qualifying institutions in 2026 may be eligible for this long-term residency visa with associated benefits.

items.title: New Zealand announces 2 major visa changes for study and graduate work
items.summary: New Zealand has announced two significant visa policy changes affecting international students and graduate workers. The changes impact study visas and post-graduation work pathways, altering the conditions under which students can study and remain in New Zealand after completing their degrees.

items.title: UK student visa bank balance requirement to increase from November 30
items.summary: The minimum bank balance requirement for UK student visa applicants from India will increase starting November 30. Indian students planning to study in the UK will need to show higher funds to meet the new financial threshold for their visa applications.

items.title: Microsoft, Adobe PERM suspensions and IBM sponsorship cuts affect Indian students
items.summary: Major US technology companies including Microsoft and Adobe have reportedly suspended PERM applications, while IBM has cut sponsorships. These developments may impact the return on investment for Indian students studying in the US who seek employer-sponsored work visas.

items.title: Ireland extends visa waiver for Indians until December 2026
items.summary: Ireland has extended its visa waiver programme for Indian nationals through December 2026. The extension allows eligible Indian travellers to continue visiting Ireland without a visa, subject to specific qualifying conditions outlined by Irish immigration authorities.

items.title: New Zealand offers 4-year post-study work visa for Indian PhD graduates
items.summary: New Zealand will grant four-year post-study work rights to Indian PhD graduates in 2026. This extended work visa allows doctoral degree holders to remain and work in New Zealand significantly longer than graduates with other qualifications.

items.title: Australia tightens family rules for graduate visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has reportedly tightened family-related rules for graduate visa applicants. The new restrictions affect the conditions under which graduate visa holders can include or sponsor family members, making the process more stringent than before.

items.title: Latest Green Card processing times for 2026
items.summary: Updated information on Green Card processing times for 2026 is now available. The processing duration varies depending on application type and category. Applicants can use this information to understand current timelines for permanent residence applications in the United States.

items.title: New Zealand moves graduate work visa online, extends PhD post-study work rights
items.summary: New Zealand has shifted graduate work visa applications to an online system and extended post-study work rights for Indian PhD graduates. The changes are designed to streamline the application process and provide longer work opportunities for doctoral degree holders from India.

items.title: Tighter visas and falling rupee shift Indian students' priorities to jobs and costs
items.summary: Indian students are increasingly prioritising job prospects and affordability over university rankings when choosing overseas education destinations. The shift is being driven by tighter visa policies in popular study destinations and the weakening rupee, which has made foreign education more expensive.

items.title: Australia's biometrics rule creates costly travel burden for Northeast Indian applicants
items.summary: Australia's visa biometrics requirement is reportedly causing financial hardship for applicants from Northeast India, who must undertake expensive journeys to biometric collection centres. The rule adds significant cost and inconvenience to the Australian visa application process for this region.

items.title: New Zealand partner visa requires stronger evidence in 2026
items.summary: New Zealand has issued updated guidance requiring stronger evidence for partner visa applications in 2026. Applicants will need to provide more comprehensive documentation to prove the genuineness of their relationship when sponsoring a partner to join them in New Zealand.

items.title: US says Green Card applicants on temporary visas must leave country to apply
items.summary: The United States has announced that applicants for Green Cards who are currently in the country on temporary visas will be required to leave the US in order to submit their permanent residence applications.

items.title: Ireland extends separate visa waiver for Indians till Dec 31
items.summary: Ireland has extended its visa waiver programme for Indian travellers until 31 December, providing a winter holiday boost. The separate waiver allows eligible Indians to visit Ireland under relaxed entry requirements for the extended period.

items.title: New Zealand selects 714 EOIs in November 2026 Parent Resident Visa draw
items.summary: New Zealand has selected 714 expressions of interest in its November 2026 Parent Resident Visa draw, clearing the queue up to June 2023. This allows selected applicants to proceed with their parent sponsorship applications.

items.title: As US tightens visa rules, Telangana, AP students make beeline for Europe
items.summary: Students from Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are increasingly choosing European destinations for higher education as the United States tightens its visa rules. The shift reflects changing preferences among Indian students seeking study abroad opportunities.

items.title: India Young Professionals Scheme visa ballot: Mistakes to avoid and preparation tips
items.summary: Guidance on the India Young Professionals Scheme visa ballot for the UK highlights common mistakes applicants should avoid. The article provides preparation advice for Indians interested in applying for this work visa programme through the ballot system.

items.title: H-1B and H-4 visa appointments widely rescheduled after online presence review
items.summary: US consulates in India have reportedly rescheduled numerous H-1B and H-4 visa appointments following the implementation of an online presence review system. The changes have affected many applicants who had existing appointment slots for these work and dependent visa categories.

items.title: Australia tightens Bridging Visa B travel rules from November 30
items.summary: Australia is changing Bridging Visa B regulations from November 30, introducing stricter travel permissions for visa applicants. The new rules will tighten the conditions under which people holding bridging visas can leave and re-enter Australia while their substantive visa applications are being processed.

items.title: Canada PR wait falls for parents, rises for Express Entry applicants
items.summary: Processing times for Canadian permanent residence applications have changed, with waiting periods decreasing for parent sponsorship cases but increasing for those applying through the Express Entry system, affecting Indian applicants in both streams.

items.title: US proposes major changes to EB-2 and EB-3 process for Indian green card applicants
items.summary: The United States has proposed significant changes to the EB-2 and EB-3 employment-based green card process. The proposed modifications will particularly impact Indian applicants who form a large portion of the employment-based immigration backlog.

items.title: Australia introduces 5 major visa changes in November 2026
items.summary: Australia has implemented five significant visa changes this month affecting visitor visas, graduate visas and skilled migration pathways. The changes impact various categories of applicants including students and skilled workers.

items.title: Ireland loses €8 million in tuition fees as student visa refusals hit Indian applicants
items.summary: High rates of student visa refusals for Indian applicants to Ireland have resulted in an estimated €8 million loss in tuition fee revenue for Irish institutions, according to recent reports.

items.title: Australia tightens 485 graduate visa rules for dependants
items.summary: Australia has tightened regulations for the 485 graduate visa, restricting which family members graduates can include as dependants. The new rules limit the types of relatives that can accompany or join graduate visa holders in Australia.

items.title: US proposes stricter green card rules to prioritise American job applicants
items.summary: The United States has proposed stricter green card regulations that would prioritise American job applicants. The proposed changes could affect the permanent residency process for foreign workers, including Indian professionals seeking to settle in the US.

items.title: New Zealand student visa approval rate for Indians falls to 64.1% in 2026
items.summary: Student visa approval rates for Indian applicants to New Zealand have dropped to 64.1 per cent in 2026. The decline represents a significant fall in acceptance rates, though the specific reasons behind this trend have not been detailed.

items.title: Indians with New Zealand job offer could face tougher visa checks, lawyer warns
items.summary: Indian nationals holding job offers from New Zealand may face stricter visa verification processes, according to a lawyer's warning. The tougher checks could add complexity to the work visa application process for those planning to move to New Zealand for employment.

items.title: US H-1B visa and green card update: Tighter sponsorship rules proposed
items.summary: New USCIS proposals include tighter sponsorship rules affecting H-1B visa holders and green card applicants. Indian professionals and graduates need to understand these proposed changes, which could impact their ability to work and obtain permanent residency in the United States.

items.title: Australia changes visitor visa rules from Nov 28; what is 'No Further Stay' rule?
items.summary: Australia is implementing changes to visitor visa regulations from November 28, introducing a 'No Further Stay' condition. The new rule will affect how visitors can extend or change their visa status while in Australia, impacting travel planning for Indians.

items.title: New Zealand launches new six-month graduate work visa: What Indian students need to know
items.summary: New Zealand has launched a new six-month graduate work visa programme. The visa allows Indian students who have completed their studies in New Zealand to gain work experience, with specific requirements and conditions that applicants should understand before applying.

items.title: New Zealand 6-month graduate work visa 2026: Eligibility, fees and rules for Indians
items.summary: New Zealand has introduced a six-month graduate work visa for 2026. Indian students who complete their studies in New Zealand can learn about the eligibility criteria, application fees and regulations governing this post-study work opportunity.

items.title: Australia changes Working Holiday visa rules from March 2027
items.summary: Australia is changing Working Holiday visa rules from March 2027. The second visa work requirement will increase to 120 days, affecting those planning to extend their working holiday stay in Australia beyond the initial visa period.

items.title: UK investor visa return unlikely as advisers recommend scrapping Innovator Founder visa
items.summary: Migration advisers have recommended scrapping or overhauling the UK Innovator Founder visa, making the return of the investor visa route unlikely. This could affect business and investment migration pathways to the United Kingdom for Indian applicants.

items.title: US offers 15-day premium processing for 27 visa categories, Indians to benefit
items.summary: The United States is offering 15-day premium processing for 27 different visa categories. Indian applicants will benefit from this faster processing option, which significantly reduces waiting times compared to standard processing. The service covers multiple visa types and provides quicker decisions for those willing to pay the premium fee.

items.title: Australia changes Temporary Graduate visa rules for international students
items.summary: Australia has introduced changes to the Temporary Graduate visa affecting international students and their families. The new rules include five key changes that families need to be aware of when planning post-study work arrangements in Australia.

items.title: New Zealand offers six-month graduate visa, four years for PhD holders
items.summary: New Zealand has introduced new graduate visa rules including a six-month work option for graduates and a four-year visa pathway for Indian PhD holders. The changes aim to provide post-study work opportunities for international graduates.

items.title: Australia tightens family-member rules for Temporary Graduate visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has tightened the rules for including family members on Temporary Graduate visa applications. The new restrictions will affect how international graduates can bring or sponsor family members while on post-study work visas in Australia.

items.title: Only 64% of Indian student visa applications approved by New Zealand in 2026
items.summary: Recent data shows that New Zealand approved only 64 per cent of student visa applications from India in 2026. The approval rate indicates that a significant portion of Indian applicants are being refused, raising questions about what factors applicants should be aware of when applying.

items.title: Indian EB-2 green card backlog stuck in 2013 as premium processing reviewed
items.summary: The employment-based EB-2 green card backlog for Indian applicants remains stuck at 2013 priority dates. Meanwhile, the White House is reviewing changes to premium processing options. The prolonged wait times continue to affect Indian professionals seeking permanent residency through the EB-2 category in the United States.

items.title: Australia tightens family rules for post-study work visas: what Indian graduates need to know
items.summary: Australia has tightened the rules regarding family member inclusion for post-study work visas. The new regulations specifically affect Indian graduates who wish to include family members in their Temporary Graduate visa applications. Applicants need to understand these stricter requirements before proceeding with their applications.

items.title: Australia to make 'No Further Stay' condition mandatory for all visitor visas soon
items.summary: Australia plans to make the 'No Further Stay' condition mandatory for all visitor visas in the near future. This condition prevents visa holders from applying for most other visas while in Australia. The change will affect visitors who may have previously considered extending their stay or switching visa categories.

items.title: Australia lists three categories exempt from four-year citizenship residence rule
items.summary: Australia has identified three specific categories of permanent residents who are exempt from the standard four-year residence requirement for citizenship. The exemptions provide alternative pathways to Australian citizenship for certain groups of permanent residents who may not meet the usual residency timeline.

items.title: UK student visa applications fall 20% in a year as tighter immigration rules bite
items.summary: Student visa applications to the UK have dropped by 20 per cent over the past year. The decline is attributed to tighter immigration rules that have affected overseas recruitment. The stricter regulations are having a measurable impact on the number of international students applying to study in Britain.

items.title: New Zealand introduces six-month graduate work visa for international students
items.summary: New Zealand has introduced a new six-month graduate work visa option for international students who have completed their studies. Indian students may be eligible to apply under the new visa category, subject to meeting specific eligibility criteria and fee requirements.

items.title: New Zealand opens one-year work visa to Graduate Diploma students
items.summary: New Zealand has opened a one-year open work visa pathway for students who complete Graduate Diploma programmes. The new visa option provides Graduate Diploma holders with the opportunity to work in New Zealand for twelve months after graduation.

items.title: US cancels 6,000 visas in crackdown against birth tourism
items.summary: The United States has cancelled 6,000 visas as part of a crackdown on birth tourism. The measure targets individuals suspected of travelling to the US primarily to give birth and secure citizenship for their children.

items.title: Canada visa processing times increase for Indian visitor and super visa applicants
items.summary: Canada has updated its visa processing times, with longer waits now reported for Indian applicants seeking visitor visas and super visas. The increased processing times will affect how long Indian nationals must wait for visa decisions.

items.title: Ireland extends visa waiver programme for Indians
items.summary: Ireland has extended its visa waiver programme that benefits Indian travellers. The programme allows eligible Indians to visit Ireland under certain conditions, making travel more accessible for those holding specific visa types.

items.title: Canada freezes intake cap for international students till 2029
items.summary: Canada has announced it will freeze the intake cap for international students until 2029 as part of its new immigration plan. This measure will limit the number of new international students who can study in Canada over the coming years.

items.title: Stricter regulations proposed for H-1B visa extensions in the US
items.summary: The United States is reportedly considering stricter regulations for H-1B visa extensions. The proposed changes could make it more difficult for H-1B visa holders to extend their work authorization, though the regulations have not yet been confirmed.

items.title: Why is it getting harder for Indians to work and settle in America?
items.summary: Recent developments including IBM's H-1B moves and tech layoffs are making it increasingly difficult for Indians to work and settle in the United States. The article examines the challenges facing Indian professionals seeking employment and permanent residence in America.

items.title: Ireland extends UK visa-linked travel waiver ahead of Christmas
items.summary: Ireland has extended its UK visa-linked travel waiver programme ahead of the Christmas season. The waiver allows certain Indian nationals holding valid UK visas to travel to Ireland without requiring a separate Irish visa.

items.title: Ireland extends UK visa waiver for Indians until December 2026
items.summary: Ireland has extended its UK visa waiver scheme for Indian travellers until December 2026. The programme allows eligible Indians with valid UK visas to enter Ireland without obtaining a separate Irish visa, subject to specific eligibility and travel rules.

items.title: US, UK lose international students as visa curbs bite
items.summary: International student enrolments have fallen significantly in the UK and US due to tightened visa restrictions, with Britain seeing a 19 per cent drop and America a 13 per cent decline. Asian countries are reportedly gaining students as a result.

items.title: Canada caps new international student arrivals at 1.5 lakh annually
items.summary: Canada's Immigration Plan for 2027 to 2029 sets an annual cap of 1.5 lakh new international student arrivals. This limit will restrict the number of foreign students who can begin their studies in Canada each year during this period.

items.title: Proposed Australian student visa rules may impact Indian applicants most
items.summary: Australia is reportedly considering new student visa rules that could affect Indian applicants more severely than students from other countries. The specific changes have not been confirmed but are expected to create additional challenges for Indian students seeking to study in Australia.
